name: Base platform, wave and circular twist

semantics.definition: The base platform laid as you drew it from the side: a wave that rises and falls, then a circular twist that comes out higher than it began, every tile square, tiles and astroids on both faces. The world’s land is laid along it. A trial: nothing is set on it yet.
semantics.responsibility: Be the one wave strip every No Origins app uses. It changes only through a proposal you approve; Mero keeps the fingerprints of the version you approved, git keeps the code.

spec.job: Lay the base platform along the line you drew.

measure.width: how wide: the base platform’s, 21 tiles
measure.runway: how long it runs flat before it rises: none
measure.end: how long it runs flat after its last curve: none
measure.slant: how far aslant it is laid, so the twist passes beside itself
measure.ease: over how many metres each change of curve is eased in
measure.run-1-long: how long run 1 is: the wave starts to rise
measure.run-3-long: how long run 3 is: over the top of the wave
measure.run-4-long: how long run 4 is: down the wave, leaning back a little
measure.run-5-long: how long run 5 is: round the bottom of the wave
measure.run-6-long: how long run 6 is: rising toward the twist
measure.run-7-long: how long run 7 is: over the top of the twist
measure.run-8-long: how long run 8 is: down its far side
measure.run-9-long: how long run 9 is: round its bottom
measure.run-10-long: how long run 10 is: up its near side
measure.run-11-long: how long run 11 is: curving out under its top
measure.run-12-long: how long run 12 is: rising out past its far side
measure.run-13-long: how long run 13 is: levelling off, higher than the start
